description: This Flutter widget defines a page for managing books, including listing, searching, pagination, and CRUD operations. It interacts with an API client to fetch book data and displays it using Flutter UI components.

classes.name: BooksPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the UI for listing and searching books, providing CRUD actions.

classes.name: _BooksPageState
classes.description: State class for BooksPage handling the UI state, data fetching, and user interactions.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget state and loads books on startup.

methods.name: _loadBooks
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches books data based on current search and page state, updating the UI accordingly.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Flutter widget tree for the books list and search controls.
